debrief db-021

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-e-d f-a-k-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-s, l-e-f-t i-n-v-a-l-i-d b-a-d-g-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d t-h-e g-o-o-d-s, l-e-f-t s-a-l-e-s r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-n-i-e-d a-l-l r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s, l-e-f-t n-o d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
